sloka: द्विजः सुहृद्भृत्यजनोऽथवा तदा ।दरिद्रभिक्षाचरणश्च योऽभवत् ।न तत्र कश्चिन्न बभूव तर्पितो ।यथार्ह सम्मानन दान सम्ब्रमैः ॥२-३२-४४॥
transliteration: dvijaḥ suhṛdbhṛtyajano'thavā tadā ।daridrabhikṣācaraṇaśca yo'bhavat ।na tatra kaścinna babhūva tarpito ।yathārha sammānana dāna sambramaiḥ ॥2-32-44॥

translations.english: Prompted by the deserving words of acclaim from his friends, Rama distributed with joy and without delay the entire wealth earned by him through dharma.
